_help: Press kit / booking page (press-kit/). bios = bio versions with a Copy button: either 'text' (your own words), or 'fromAbout': 'first' / 'all' to use the About text of the Home page automatically (so it never goes out of date). highlights = automatic: every award in awards.json with "highlight": true is listed (won first); set "pressKit": false on an award to leave it out. facts = optional short label/value lines (e.g. {"label": "Languages", "value": "Hindi, Marathi, English"}); only add facts you are sure of. photos = approved photos for press: src (image in assets/img/), alt (describes the photo), label, credit (photographer, shown next to the photo; leave empty if unknown), approved (true/false: only 'true' photos are shown). Visitors can download the photo from the page. downloads = optional files (e.g. a one-page PDF): label, path (e.g. assets/press/onesheet.pdf), note. booking = heading, text and the e-mail for requests (empty email = the address from site.json). links = extra buttons below the contact text.
intro: Everything organisers, journalists and partners need in one place: bio, recognition, photos and how to get in touch.
